full_judgment: 4. Defendant No. 1, the Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh represented by Deputy Commissioner, Sylhet contested the suit by filing a written objection denying the material allegation of the plaintiff and contending, inter alia, that the suit land including other land known as Balaganj Bazar has been classified as hat and the same vested in the government under section 20 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act 1950 as non retainable khas land of the ex-rent receiver and is under management of the Government and the said Bazar including the suit premises has been leased out to the Union Parishad for a period of 9 years for collection of toll; that the plaintiff has created some fraudulent documents with a view to grab the suit property and that the sebait is not entitled to lease out any debottar property as per provisions of section 10A of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act and that the application for temporary injunction is liable to be rejected.
